user_message: JSON serialization of candidate_answer and reference_answer only
reference_answer_source: Original reference: row.solution for MATH500 and BBH; metadata.final_answer[0] for OlympiadBench. Preserve original reference content.
trace_timeout_policy: Apply old extraction to existing text; retain finish_reason separately; do not automatically label a timeout response incorrect.
request_policy: one rollout per request; no cross-rollout mixing
rate_limit_policy: bounded concurrency ramp; honor Retry-After; exponential backoff with jitter; reduce pressure on repeated 429
failure_policy: API errors, invalid JSON and context overflow are technical errors, never coerced to is_correct=false
resume_policy: cache by source SHA256 + exact prompt/config hash; persist each valid result atomically
submission_policy: No model calls or job submission before user approves prompt; then CPU job with validated network egress and a small pilot before full ramp
credential_policy: Use user-authorized credential without writing it to prompt, source code, Slurm script, command-line arguments, or logs
candidate_answer_source: Exact output of the original dataset extractor (the predicted field where available and source-verified). It may be the entire original response. Do not apply additional OlympiadBench preprocess or suppress full-text fallback; the judge identifies the final answer from this content.
empty_candidate_policy: is_correct=false with local extraction_missing status; avoid unnecessary API call; keep separate from model judgment
technical_extraction_failure_policy: Track extraction exceptions separately; retry or investigate, never coerce technical failure into semantic wrong answer. A successful extractor returning full text is allowed.
